thread:
lina-pm: FYI our SI partner UberEdge is blocked: marketplace image verification failing for GovCloud deploy. Go-live scheduled Thurs. Need a quick arch triage + escalation.
jared-se: Can you paste the partner error?
lina-pm: They sent: "AccessDenied: arn:aws:sts::999999999:assumed-role/marketplace-role is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer". Partner points at replicated ECR layers failing.
ravi-eng: Sounds like cross-account ECR/KMS perms. Could also be commercial vs govcloud partition mismatch. Paging @meilin-sre and @aisha-sec.
meilin-sre: I'll check VPC egress and endpoint usage. If partner is pulling from GovCloud they must use gov endpoints and Gov IP ranges. Do we have any recent marketplace replication changes?
jared-se: I'll attempt a quick pull with their role in our staging account to repro. Need the role ARN.
lina-pm: Partner provided ARN: arn:aws:iam::888888888:role/uberedge-marketplace-replica
ravi-eng: Minimal IAM change to test: allow ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer + ecr:BatchGetImage for that role. If KMS blocks decryption across accounts we'll need key policy change.
jared-se: Local snippet I used for repro: ```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],
  "Resource":"*"
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job 'replicate-uberedge-test' to staging at 15:05 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/replicate-uberedge-test
meilin-sre: Partner confirmed their NAT only allows commercial AWS ranges. Asked them to open GovCloud ranges and confirm routing to us. Also check that their CI uses gov partition endpoints.
aisha-sec: If we edit the KMS key policy to allow this role, we need org-owner signoff for an exception. I'll join the emergency call at 14:30 to approve a temporary policy entry.
lina-pm: Added 14:30 call invite. I'll DM partner and push our go-live checklist.
jared-se: Update: staging job shows same AccessDenied. After adding the ecr perms to the replica role the pull progressed but failed on kms:Decrypt in logs.
ravi-eng: So KMS key policy is the culprit. We can either add the partner role to key policy for decrypt or provide a pre-signed artifact in GovCloud as a short-term workaround.
thomas-ops: Quick fallback: publish a partner-hosted AMI in GovCloud for the immediate go-live. It avoids marketplace pull but is manual. Recommend if we can't get key change before go-live.
aisha-sec: I'll fast-track a limited key policy change for testing, with requirement to revert/tighten post-go-live and add audit alert on cross-account Decrypt. Filing ticket now.
lina-pm: Partner test on staging succeeded after temporary KMS entry and ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer permission. They say marketplace validation now passes. Monitoring.
jared-se: Good. After go-live we need a follow-up to remove the temporary policy and document the permanent required posture.
aisha-sec: Filed security ticket: PROD-4321 (KMS cross-account audit + policy hardening).
lina-pm: Thanks all. Will run a final smoke with partner tomorrow morning and close this thread after confirmation. :thumbsup:
